# BD Solar Power (bdsolarpower.com)

> Independent reference on solar energy in Bangladesh: current system prices,
> net metering rules, government incentives, ROI figures and installation
> guidance. Based in Mymensingh, serving all of Bangladesh.

## Key facts

- 5kW rooftop system price (2026): BDT 275,000-350,000, installed.
- Typical payback period: 3-4 years; panel lifespan 25 years.
- Solar import duty in Bangladesh: 1% (reduced from earlier rates).
- Net metering is available for systems up to 100kW under BPDB rules.
- Contact: hello@bdsolarpower.com, WhatsApp +880 1711 927755.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bdsolarpower.com/): Solar panel prices, savings calculator and FAQs for Bangladesh.
- [Solar Dashboard](https://bdsolarpower.com/dashboard): Live national solar capacity, projects and tender data.
- [AI Tools](https://bdsolarpower.com/ai-tools): Rooftop photo analysis and solar policy summariser.
- [Investors](https://bdsolarpower.com/investors): Market metrics, project comparison and portfolio tools.
- [Learn](https://bdsolarpower.com/learn): Beginner guides to solar technology and net metering.
- [Blog](https://bdsolarpower.com/blog): Articles on pricing, policy, incentives and technology.
